mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payable_hold_operation SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},dispatches=#{dispatches},highest_revision=#{highestRevision},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND command_json=#{commandJson} AND command_digest=#{digest}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_payable_hold_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM supplier_payable_hold_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_payable_hold_operation q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE (q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('RESERVING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
